title: feat(admin): refresh running job progress without reloading (#204)
body:
Refs #204 — **draft for code review only. Do not merge; founder GO/NO-GO pending.** Base: `c48e307efe7750d0fb36015c39d50a34675f9579` · Previous head: `1e218cb8cab63d796dd4440aa17e6eeff59b5abd` · Head: `19e2c6892c5887bb53a4a470979a44d3822e3480` (`test(admin): exhaustively verify progress row/focus reconciliation (#204)`, plus a docs wording follow-up) ## Scope - Authenticated read-only `wp_ajax_writeleash_free_progress` (+ explicit nopriv refusal): user `0` gets a generic 403 before any repository read; job-bound nonce, capability + creator/approver/administrator authorization, bounded offset/filter. - Endpoint reads **only persisted** plan/job/item/Undo state — no schema install, no worker/Resume invocation, no product read, no cache eviction; missing saved evidence disables actions and polling. - Isolated `free-progress.js`: updates counters/outcomes/action availability, preserves page-load current-price cells, labels filtered rows as needing reload, handles stalled/partial/error/session states, records last successful refresh, generation fence for out-of-order responses, single in-flight request, 15 s timeout, hidden-page pause, 10/20/40 s backoff, stops after four failures or terminal jobs; focus-preserving with concise polite announcements; native refresh/no-JS retained. - Minimal asset additions: explicit manifest, public-asset allowlist entry, ownership registration. ## Review fix pass (HEAD `1e218cb`) - **A — row/page sync (fixed):** `updateRows()` now reconciles rendered row order to the durable server page order via `insertBefore`; previously new rows were appended and existing rows never moved, so the visible list could disagree with the current filter/page. A focused row is never moved (moving a focused node drops focus): it keeps its place and the other rows are ordered around it; with no focus the server order is exact. Regression verified: the pre-fix client fails the new reorder test. - **A — focused stale indicator (wording fixed):** focused outcome cells, focused removed review links and focused initial support details now explicitly state they still show the previous saved details/view until focus leaves. Mechanism unchanged (connection line as indicator; focused nodes retained until blur). - **A — verified unchanged:** Apply/Undo counters, attention classes, generation fence, 401/403 stop + backoff, four-failure stop, hidden pause/resume, terminal poll stop, announcement de-duplication, no-JS mount, no framework. - **B — verified unchanged:** actor/capability + job-bound nonce before reads; identical two-key refusal for anonymous/cross-actor/guessed IDs; endpoint read-only (no mutation/worker); `process_resume`/`process_undo` independently re-check capability, POST, dependency, job, action nonce, actor authorization, terminal/resumable state and plan binding; missing durable evidence fails closed. - **Pager selector checked against `render_pager`:** the single `

` has the Previous control first and the Next control last, so `querySelector('p').lastElementChild` is correct for both the link and disabled-button shapes; no selector change needed (terminal shape now pinned by test). ## Fix-pass tests - `progress-client.cjs`: server-order reconciliation (with/without focus), focused stale wording, focused removed row/link, filter/page change with no stale rows, empty-state removal, pager `next_url` create/update/hide/show + terminal disabled-button shape, 401 and 403 stop, first-failure backoff message, timeout abort + retry, hidden pause/resume, four-failure stop, announcement de-dup, PHP constant/action/field parity and every JS `data-*` selector checked against the PHP renderer, no-framework assertion. - `progress-unit.php`: job-bound nonce mismatch, guessed public ID with a valid nonce (visibility lookup only), missing/non-string nonce, method case, offset at/over the real `MAX_EVIDENCE_ROWS` (double now mirrors `class-undo-repository.php`), extra repository-failure paths, and `__callStatic` mutation sentinels + `Job_Worker`/`Undo_Worker` sentinels asserted empty (negative controls confirmed). - `progress-integration.php`: guessed-public-ID refusal now audited through the poll-only SQL/product-read wrapper (Docker-bound, NOT_TESTED). ## Behavior changes 1. Row-order reconciliation in `free-progress.js` (the only synchronization behavior change). 2. Explicit stale wording for focused nodes. Justification in `docs/review/204/IMPLEMENTATION.md` §“2026-10-08 review fix pass”. Files in the fix commit: `wordpress/writeleash/includes/free/free-progress.js`, `wordpress/tests/admin/progress-client.cjs`, `wordpress/tests/admin/progress-unit.php`, `wordpress/tests/admin/progress-integration.php`, `docs/review/204/IMPLEMENTATION.md`. Support-claim impact: none (no listing/supported ceilings changed). Deviations: none. ## Local validation (PASS unless noted) - `node wordpress/tests/admin/progress-client.cjs` PASS · `php wordpress/tests/admin/progress-unit.php` PASS · admin-audit · package-preflight (43-file closure) · inventory · public-audit-cases · test-artifact (10) · ownership + dependency · readme · historical-shim · guard-control (real manifest accepted; unknown/unreferenced assets and `new $class` rejected) · lint + `git diff --check` PASS. - GitNexus `detect_changes` complete for the fix commit (5 files / 73 symbols / 14 flows, risk high — dominated by test-double and doc symbol churn; the edited production symbol `updateRows` is LOW and `progress_snapshot` LOW), no partial/truncated. - **`pr-fast.sh` FAILS only at the unchanged #170 UI evidence gate** (`asset-audit.php:100`); log byte-identical to the prior run apart from timing. ## NOT_TESTED (blocked) - Real Woo poll audit and real AJAX session journey (`progress-integration.php` extended, not executed), real browser keyboard/live-update/accessibility (axe), expired-session behavior — Docker/browser unavailable in this runtime. Real-browser row reorder/refocus behavior after DOM moves remains the main uncertainty the deterministic DOM tests cannot settle. ## Round-3 verification (HEAD `19e2c68`) Test/document-only commit; **no production code changed and no production defect demonstrated**. Round 3 started at `1e218cb8…`; `origin/main` unchanged at `c48e307e…`. - **Exhaustive `updateRows()` order/focus enumeration (0 violations):** shipped `free-progress.js` executed under the deterministic DOM harness with every server page order for n=1..4 × every focus position (none; each seeded row, including rows present in the server list at every position and rows being removed; a row created during reconciliation cannot hold focus, so the reachable equivalent is focus on a retained row while another row is added). Result: **9,996 cases, 69,481 assertion checks, 1,198 focused-removed deferrals, 0 violations** for: no duplicates; final set = server set; non-focused rows keep server relative order; focused rows never moved/removed; exact server order without focus; a focused removed row defers the whole previous view with its explicit message (documented policy). - **Sensitivity:** the updated suite exits 1 against the pre-fix client `6a6a9ac`; an expanded task-owned enumeration (35,491 cases) reports 30,949 violations against the pre-fix client vs 0 against the shipped client. - **Read-only endpoint audit:** `handle_progress()`/`progress_snapshot()` perform only the actor/capability/POST gate, job-bound nonce, bounded offset/filter, `Job_Schema::ready` (option + `information_schema` SELECTs), `read_by_public_id`, `observe`, `hydrate_plan`, `history_job`, `observe`, `history_items` (all SELECT/join reads) and response formatting; no install, worker, Resume, product read, cache eviction or repository mutation; failures fail closed `UNAVAILABLE`. - **Sentinel strengthening:** doubles now assert exact reads-only method sets; `Job_Worker::callback`, `Undo_Worker::queue_undo`/`callback` sentinels added; self-controls prove the mutation sentinel intercepts all 16 job + 18 undo production writer names and the worker sentinels record all six entrypoints, with state restored before the end-of-suite assertions. - **Resume/Undo authority citations:** `process_resume` re-checks `can_mutate` (:604), exact POST (:607), dependency (:610), job regex/read (:612), action+job-bound nonce (:616-619), actor (:621), terminal (:624), `can_manual_run` (:627), plan binding (:631), per-product rights (:637) before `Job_Worker::run` (:643); `process_undo` mirrors this (:664-681), delegates durable checks to `Undo_Repository::initiate` under `FOR UPDATE` (:123-209) and re-checks terminal state (:695) before `Undo_Worker::run` (:699). New tests cover POST/capability/job-regex/job-bound nonce/action-mixed nonce/cross-actor/terminal-Resume-with-valid-nonce/`resume_available=true` and prove the process bodies never read `resume_available`/`undo_available`/`undo_button`/resume/undo nonces. - **Battery (PASS):** progress-client (9,996-case enumeration) · progress-unit (handler authority + sentinels) · admin-audit · package-preflight · inventory · public-audit-cases · test-artifact · ownership · dependency · readme · historical-shim · lint + `git diff --check`. `pr-fast.sh` **FAILS only at the unchanged #170 UI evidence gate** (`asset-audit.php:100`), output byte-identical to the prior receipt after timing normalization. GitNexus `detect_changes` all+staged complete (3 files / 14 symbols / 17 flows) and branch `compare` vs main complete (12 files / 165 symbols / 20 flows), risk critical from test-double/doc symbol churn, no partial/truncated. - **NOT_TESTED (unchanged):** no WP/Woo runtime or browser environment — `/var/run/docker.sock` absent (`docker info` fails), uid 1000 with `newuidmap`/`newgidmap` absent and `nf_tables` not loaded, `browser-tools` declares Playwright/axe but no `node_modules` installed. Real-browser live Apply/Undo, keyboard, axe, expired-session journeys and Docker-bound `progress-integration.php` remain NOT_TESTED; no browser/Woo claim is made. Full accounting: `docs/review/204/IMPLEMENTATION.md` (this branch). Lead report: `docs/review/parallel-20261008-handoff/FINAL-REPORT.md` (local workspace, not pushed). ## Round-4 runtime defect fix (HEAD `fd0dc73`) Previous HEAD: `19e2c6892c5887bb53a4a470979a44d3822e3480`; new HEAD: `fd0dc73e8a1598da1c894a6be24be28f860c286d`; `origin/main` unchanged at `c48e307e…`. Real-browser acceptance against the integrated candidate (WordPress 7.1.2, WooCommerce 11.1.2, MySQL 8.0.44, host Chrome via Playwright 1.61) reproduced a genuine live-progress defect. - **Defect:** after the first successful poll, `free-progress.js` replaced the server-rendered Apply/Undo conflict cell text with the short `reason_message()` variants (`Not changed · The product changed after review; …` / `Not restored · The product changed after WriteLeash applied its price; …`), so the merchant-visible guidance silently changed wording and the real-browser journey failed at `readable Undo preservation` (`regression-browser.cjs:275`; the Apply check at ~:259 passed only by pre-poll timing). Host dump: `/tmp/wlruntime/evidence/round4-defect/live-undo-page-dump.txt`; DB outcomes were correct (`UNDO_CONFLICT` recorded, prices preserved). - **Root cause:** `progress_snapshot()` composed rows from short reason strings while `render_item_outcome()` embedded the long guidance locally — two spellings of one message. - **Fix (production, `class-free-admin.php` only):** new `outcome_conflict_copy( ?string $state )` holding the two long sentences (U+2019 preserved); `render_item_outcome()` prints from the helper (no behavior change); `progress_snapshot()` uses `' · ' . ` for `CONFLICT`/`UNDO_CONFLICT` and keeps the existing `reason_message()` fallback otherwise, including the `null === undo_state` branch. No other text, labels, attention flags or read-only behavior changed. - **Regression + discriminator:** `progress-unit.php` now parameterizes the conflict fixture and asserts exact long copy for CONFLICT (null reason and `ITEM_CONFLICT`) and `UNDO_CONFLICT`, short variants absent, and each long sentence stored once (148 checks). `progress-client.cjs` extracts both sentences from the PHP source and asserts verbatim cell writes and focused-outcome deferral (9,996 cases / 69,481 checks, 0 violations). Both PASS; the updated unit suite fails against pre-fix bytes `19e2c68` at the first new check (exit 255) — see `evidence/pr-fix4/221/`. - **Impact receipts:** pre-edit upstream `render_item_outcome` HIGH (5 impacted, render / render_job_view / render_preview_view flows); `progress_snapshot` LOW (caller `handle_progress`). `detect_changes --scope all` + `--scope staged`: 19 symbols / 4 files, complete, no partial/truncated (critical risk dominated by test-double/doc name-collision over-attribution). - **Battery (PASS):** progress-client · progress-unit · admin-audit · package-preflight · inventory · public-audit-cases · readme · historical-shim · ownership (admin) · dependency · lint + `git diff --check`. `pr-fast.sh` FAILS only at the preserved #170 UI evidence gate; output byte-identical to the prior receipt after timing normalization. - **Remaining blockers (unchanged):** real-browser re-verification of the polled Apply/Undo conflict rows is performed by the lead on the integrated candidate after this push; Docker/WP/Woo browser runtime remains unavailable here, so the Docker-bound `progress-integration.php` and the full `regression-browser.cjs` journey are NOT_TESTED in this clone. ## Round 4 — runtime acceptance and browser-reproduced defect fix Real-browser journey on the integrated candidate found the polled rows rewrote conflict guidance (short `reason_message` variants) after load; fixed in `fd0dc73` by sharing one conflict-copy source between the server render and `progress_snapshot()` (regression added; pre-fix bytes fail the new assertion). - `#170` journeys (Chromium 148 + Firefox 151, 253 assertions each) + live-polling test: **PASS** — counters advanced 0→10 changed / 22→12 remaining with `noReload` intact and automatic updates active. - `progress-integration.php` (persisted Apply/Undo, actor/nonce bounds, read-only SQL/product-read audit, conflict/terminal, no-JS/missing evidence): **PASS** on MySQL default and Redis. - `#111` Admin E2E: **PASS 838 assertions** on default and Redis. ## Round 5 — final verification Integrated rebuild is byte-identical to the validated candidate (`330859f`); #170 both engines PASS with genuine refreshed captures on the candidate; live-polling evidence re-verified. **Recommendation: GO FOR REVIEW** (per-step #170 refresh or authorized integration PR).
